watches.name: Vespera GMT Dark
watches.description: The Nadir Vespera GMT is ready for adventure - whether you're exploring remote trails, navigating city streets, or riding far beyond the map. Its black dial with a subtle brushing ensures high readability in all light conditions, while the GMT function keeps you grounded in multiple time zones at once. The "diamond-like" coated case makes it more scratch-resistant than regular steel. Each piece is individually numbered and part of a strictly limited run of only 50 units . As an extra , Vespera GMT also includes a black leather watch roll in the box, so you can carry it safely wherever your journey takes you. Can be paired with: hand-crafted Italian leather strap FKM rubber strap

specsRaw.As an extra: , Vespera GMT also includes a black leather watch roll in the box, so you can carry it safely wherever your journey takes you.
specsRaw.Movement: Miyota 9075 Japanese Automatic Movement with GMT function. Self-winding and hacking mechanism, 28800bph and 42-hour power reserve
specsRaw.Crown: Single crown, screw-down with embossed Nadir logo
specsRaw.Hands: Polish/matte decorated hands with Super-LumiNova BGW9 and CW3 (on GMT hand)
specsRaw.Crystal: Domed Sapphire crystal with 4 layers of anti-reflective coating
specsRaw.Case Back: Screw-down stainless steel case-back with embossed pattern and a serial number
specsRaw.Hand-made: with Italian Pueblo leather: Badalassi Carlo (sourced in Tuscany) with quick-release
specsRaw.Dimensions Case: 42 mm Case thickness: 13,1 mm Lug to lug: 47 mm Lug width: 22 mm
specsRaw.Note to EU customers: All prices are shown including VAT. No extra fees (taxes/duties/customs) are required.
specsRaw.Non-EU customers: Tax is included on EU orders only. VAT is not included in the price. Local customs fees and taxes may apply.
specsRaw.Miyota 9075: The 24-hour hand keeps track of your home time, while the jumping hour lets you instantly set the local time whenever you cross into a new zone. All of this is achieved through a single screw-down crown, making it simple, reliable, and ready for any journey.
specsRaw.Vespera: means "evening" in Latin. The intention of naming a tool watch "Vespera" is to evoke a sense of adventure, transition, and timeless exploration. It adds a symbolic layer to the watch, inviting wearers to embrace the journey that unfolds as they venture into their own adventures or daily activities.
specsRaw.Exchange rate fluctuations: currency values change daily, and our system updates automatically.
specsRaw.Rounding adjustments: small differences may appear to keep prices clear and consistent.
specsRaw.Yes - our watches are designed as tools: durable, reliable, and ready for outdoor adventures while still fitting seamlessly into everyday use.
specsRaw.True GMT: best for travelling across time zones
specsRaw.Caller GMT: best for tracking another time zone from home
specsRaw.You can read more about the difference h: Our blog post about a True GMT
